## Introduction

Descriptive summary, SVD/t-SNE [@vandermaaten2008tsne] and a transcriptome-wide association scan of
child BMI z-score (WHO) on each HELIX [@vrijheid2014helix] transcript cluster, adjusted for ancestry
PCs and blood cell-type proportions.

## Setup

The analysis runs in Julia [@bezanson2017julia]; `ExposomicsJulia` provides the shared helpers and models, together with DataFrames.jl [@bouchetvalat2023dataframes].

```{julia}
#| label: setup
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Plots, LinearAlgebra, Statistics, Distributions, TSne
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## Analysis

```{julia}
#| label: analysis
phenotype   = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "phenotype.arrow")));
genexpr     = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "genexpr.arrow")));       # transcripts × samples, first column `feature`
genexpr_cov = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "genexpr_cov.arrow")));
```

Per-gene summary statistics:

```{julia}
#| label: analysis-2
G = Matrix{Float64}(genexpr[:, 2:end])
MV = DataFrame(gene = genexpr.feature, mean = vec(mean(G; dims = 2)), sd = vec(std(G; dims = 2)),
               q25 = [quantile(r, 0.25) for r in eachrow(G)],
               q50 = [quantile(r, 0.50) for r in eachrow(G)],
               q75 = [quantile(r, 0.75) for r in eachrow(G)])
```

SVD and t-SNE of the samples:

```{julia}
#| label: analysis-3
#| eval: false   # t-SNE of 1007 × 28738 takes several minutes
X = permutedims(G)                       # samples × genes
svd_gene = svd(X);
var_expl = svd_gene.S .^ 2 / sum(svd_gene.S .^ 2)
PCA_gene = svd_gene.U * Diagonal(svd_gene.S)
y_tsne = tsne(X, 2, 50, 1000, 15, pca_init = true, progress = false);
```

Transcriptome-wide association with BMI z-score (`exposure_scan`):

```{julia}
#| label: analysis-4
genexpr_t = permutedims(genexpr, :feature, :ID);
DT = innerjoin(genexpr_cov, phenotype[:, [:ID, :hs_zbmi_who]], on = :ID);
DT = innerjoin(DT, genexpr_t, on = :ID);
DT = DT[completecases(DT), :];

gene_names = genexpr.feature
covars = [:ethn_PC1, :ethn_PC2, :NK_6, :Bcell_6, :CD4T_6, :CD8T_6, :Gran_6, :Mono_6]
@time ewas_results = exposure_scan(Float64.(DT.hs_zbmi_who), Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, gene_names]),
                                   Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, covars]); names = gene_names)
```

Volcano-style plot:

```{julia}
#| label: analysis-5
ewas2 = ewas_results[abs.(ewas_results.beta) .< 10.0, :]
scatter(ewas2.beta, -log10.(ewas2.p_value), color = ifelse.(ewas2.bonferroni, "aqua", "coral2"),
        size = (400, 300), label = "")
```
